  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.components.endpoints.CompositeEndPoint
      • fr.sorbonne_u.components.endpoints.BCMCompositeEndPoint

  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbstractEndPointI, BCMCompositeEndPointI, CompositeEndPointI, java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Cloneable

    public class CompositeURIServiceEndpoint
extends BCMCompositeEndPoint
    The class CompositeURIServiceEndpoint implements the composite end point for the SingleURIConsumerCI and MultipleURIConsumerCI component interfaces.
